title: dimensions profiles
description: Editor aid for profiles.json: the combinations of dimension values that exist, by name. Once profiles exist, only their combinations do, and the dimensions they cover have no default. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that dimensions and values are declared, that every profile names the same dimensions, and that no two profiles are the same combination, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

profile.description: One value for each dimension the profiles cover.
